items.title: Albert Warner Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: well then that's where Beansy was running the place

ctx.x: Davey Jones was in there after you or before you?

Oh, he must have got in there after us. Mm-hmm. Yeah, after us. You see, because after I left Rene, I went playing with some other fellas there. Some little scrap band they had. I don't remember what band it was. Then right after I left, well then that's where Beansy was running the place, well then he cut them down. They went to playing percentage, you see, and that's where Rene left, you see.
